translations: So stand firm as you are commanded
and (those) who turn (in repentance) with you
puzzle.hint: A command for steadfastness and obedience without excess, with reminder of Allah's watchfulness
puzzle.arabic: فَٱسْتَقِمْ كَمَآ أُمِرْتَ وَمَن تَابَ مَعَكَ وَلَا تَطْغَوْا۟ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌۭ
puzzle.verseEn: So remain on a right course as you have been commanded, [you] and those who have turned back with you [to Allāh], and do not transgress. Indeed, He is Seeing of what you do.
